admission.authentication: trusted host authenticates subject/session and exact provider data-processing consent; not client JSON
admission.clock: explicit trusted integer-second host clock; rechecked after lock waiting and before result commit
admission.authority_expiry: absolute, maximum 300 seconds; immutable across retries
admission.daily_quota: atomic count of reserved initial attempts, no refunds; not a price or input-token cap
admission.checked_transport: generate_authorized rechecks the original claim, denial, expiry, provider binding and deadline after credential/TLS preparation, before POST
admission.legacy_transport: direct generate remains a trusted transport-only API, not authenticated ingress; legacy adapters retain pre-call checks only
admission.provider_configuration: public provider and provider_binding are readonly; declared binding rechecked before use and result commit

persistence.scope: trusted local host with bounded replicas
persistence.unversioned_predecessor: reject without dropping requests or denials, including empty predecessor tables
persistence.incomplete_known_schema: reject missing tables or policy row

recovery.after_uncertainty: bounded readback only; never generation replay
recovery.provider_result_binding: exact correlation key required; transport adapter remains trusted host code

inventory_pagination.cursor: next_after is last returned key only when another row exists
inventory_pagination.concurrent_insert_before_cursor: requires a new scan from the empty cursor

denial.capacity: suspend entire registry; do not evict denials
denial.clock_failure: use last committed observation for emergency denial

concrete_provider.credentials: trusted bounded callable; no environment/source fallback
concrete_provider.tls: system trust roots with hostname and certificate verification

not_implemented: live provider tenant, retention, billing and abuse qualification
remote foreground job cancellation or authoritative recovery
hard process/service isolation and production egress governance
encrypted metadata storage, retention and backup anti-rollback
claim_ceiling: Source and deterministic tests only until exact-head CI and independent acceptance. Not full HG-0087/model closure or E5-E7.
